use typenum::{
    Diff, Exp, Gcf, Integer, Length, Mod, N3, P5, Prod, Quot, Shleft, Shright, Sum, U2, U3, U4, U5,
    U7, U12, U13, U18, Unsigned,
};

fn value<T: Unsigned>() -> u64 {
    T::to_u64()
}

trait State {
    type Size: Unsigned;
}
impl State for [u16; 3] {
    type Size = Prod<U3, U2>;
}
impl State for [u32; 13] {
    type Size = Prod<U13, U4>;
}

fn main() {
    assert_eq!(value::<<[u16; 3] as State>::Size>(), 6);
    assert_eq!(value::<<[u32; 13] as State>::Size>(), 52);
    let values = [
        value::<Sum<U2, U3>>(),
        value::<Diff<U13, U5>>(),
        value::<Prod<U7, U5>>(),
        value::<Quot<U13, U5>>(),
        value::<Mod<U13, U5>>(),
        value::<Shleft<U13, U3>>(),
        value::<Shright<U13, U2>>(),
        value::<Gcf<U12, U18>>(),
        value::<Exp<U3, U4>>(),
        value::<Length<U13>>(),
    ];
    assert_eq!(values, [5, 8, 35, 2, 3, 104, 3, 6, 81, 4]);
    let _: typenum::U8 = U13::new() - U5::new();
    let _: typenum::U2 = U13::new() / U5::new();
    let _: typenum::U3 = U13::new() % U5::new();
    let signed = <Diff<N3, P5> as Integer>::to_i64();
    assert_eq!(signed, -8);
    println!("typenum {:?} {}", values, signed);
}
